freeze: Original campaign and native configurations, standalone source/declaration bytes, parameters, native protocol, implementation and root/native/observer lock and actual runtime identities before dispatch
session_policy: Immutable root freeze and append-only numbered sessions. Every new session links the preceding sealed session manifest. Resume verifies all prior sessions and accepted native archives; unsealed sessions cannot be resumed.
attempt_policy: Attempt each remaining slot once per explicit run/resume session. Each dispatched attempt has a fresh retained directory and links its previous dispatched attempt manifest. First complete accepted attempt permanently satisfies its slot; later failed, interrupted and unattempted evidence is never erased.
process_policy: Sequential supervised native m4-study commands. Outer deadline does not alter native stage budgets. Forward interruption and allow native owner to reap numerical workers before sealing; bounded cleanup fallback. Global interruption stops later dispatch.
reporting: Full cell/repetition and source/scenario planned denominators, every attempt and null/missing evidence. Aggregate execution and identity accounting only; no pooled scientific contrasts, source tuning, outcome-driven changes or winner selection.
reconstruction: Explicit standard-library native reader and saved campaign identities; no supplied source or numerical runtime execution. Fresh external report directory only. Failed/incomplete evidence requires explicit allow-failed.
limits: Trusted local synthetic m4-study configurations only. No automatic installation, human observations, general task dispatch, independent usability, biological validity, treatment result or public release. Hard-killed unsealed sessions remain forensic evidence and require a fresh campaign rather than automatic recovery.
